hooks.command: bash .loopos/tmux-worker.sh log session_start 2>/dev/null || true; tmux list-sessions -F "#{session_name}" 2>/dev/null | grep "^loopos-" | while IFS= read -r s; do tmux kill-session -t "$s" 2>/dev/null; done

bash .loopos/tmux-worker.sh log session_end 2>/dev/null || true; tmux list-sessions -F "#{session_name}" 2>/dev/null | grep "^loopos-" | while IFS= read -r s; do tmux kill-session -t "$s" 2>/dev/null; done
hooks.statusMessage: Killing loopos tmux workers on session end
